messageTemplate: Hmm. The market found a pile of gold with a {{benchmarkReturnPercent}}% gain, and you stepped in drowner brain with {{portfolioReturnPercent}}%. Fuck.
mainReasonTemplate: You managed to lose coin while the market rallied.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Meditate and rethink your mutations.

messageTemplate: I could explain why your portfolio is down {{portfolioReturnPercent}}% while the index is up {{benchmarkReturnPercent}}%, but it would require you to understand basic arithmetic. Bazinga.
mainReasonTemplate: You are negatively correlated with success.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Perhaps switch to a less intellectually demanding hobby.

messageTemplate: {{currentDrawdownFromATH}}% below peak. Looks like a griffin took a massive bite out of your coin pouch. Best brew a swallow potion and wait it out.
mainReasonTemplate: You are deep in the swamps of a drawdown.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Stop picking fights with higher level monsters.

messageTemplate: Your portfolio is down {{currentDrawdownFromATH}}%. It's in a state of rapid entropy, decaying faster than a radioactive isotope. Fascinating. From a purely observational standpoint, of course.
mainReasonTemplate: Your wealth is dissolving.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Accept the inevitability of thermodynamics.

messageTemplate: Market's bleeding {{benchmarkReturnPercent}}%. You're bleeding {{portfolioReturnPercent}}%. You should have brought the silver sword, but instead you brought a butter knife.
mainReasonTemplate: You underperformed the market on a bloody day.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Visit an armorer.

messageTemplate: While the benchmark gracefully declined by {{benchmarkReturnPercent}}%, you plummeted by {{portfolioReturnPercent}}%. It's like comparing the orbit of Mercury to a rock falling down an elevator shaft.
mainReasonTemplate: Your gravity is stronger than the market's.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Try investing in frictionless vacuums.

messageTemplate: Market's down {{benchmarkReturnPercent}}%, but you're up {{portfolioReturnPercent}}%. Hmm. Must have cast a Quen sign on your bags before leaving the inn.
mainReasonTemplate: You survived a bloodbath.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Keep your guard up. The monsters return at night.

messageTemplate: You achieved a {{portfolioReturnPercent}}% gain against the market's {{benchmarkReturnPercent}}% loss. I suspect a catastrophic rounding error in your broker's system, but I will let you have your moment.
mainReasonTemplate: You defied the laws of market physics.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Enjoy it before the regression to the mean.

messageTemplate: New all-time high. Enjoy it while it lasts. The monsters always come back when the sun goes down.
mainReasonTemplate: You reached the peak.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Prepare your oils for the inevitable drop.

messageTemplate: Your portfolio has reached a new local maximum. Just remember, what goes up must eventually succumb to the gravitational pull of market regression. Bazinga.
mainReasonTemplate: You hit a new ATH.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Prepare for the downward parabola.

messageTemplate: {{dailyWorstAsset}} is dragging you down by {{worstAssetReturn}}%, like a water hag pulling you into the muck. Toss it a coin, or cut it loose.
mainReasonTemplate: One asset is poisoning your portfolio.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Time to draw the silver sword.

messageTemplate: Your allocation to {{dailyWorstAsset}}, which is down {{worstAssetReturn}}%, is the weak link in an already unimpressive chain. Even Penny would have sold it.
mainReasonTemplate: You are stubbornly holding a loser.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Re-evaluate your entirely flawed thesis.

messageTemplate: {{dailyBestAsset}} is up {{bestAssetReturn}}%, doing all the heavy lifting. The rest of your bags are just useless peasants waiting to be eaten.
mainReasonTemplate: One asset is carrying your entire net worth.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Hope it doesn't get tired.

messageTemplate: It appears {{dailyBestAsset}} is solely responsible for your positive return. The rest of your portfolio is essentially dead weight, much like Howard Wolowitz in a theoretical physics symposium.
mainReasonTemplate: Your diversification strategy is a failure.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Pray to whatever deity governs your luck.

messageTemplate: Nothing happened today. Wind's howling. At least you didn't lose your coin to a striga, so there's that.
mainReasonTemplate: The market did nothing.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Play Gwent instead.

messageTemplate: Your portfolio remained entirely static today. It's almost as boring as a lecture by the geology department. Almost.
mainReasonTemplate: Your wealth is stationary.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Do not attempt to interact with it.

messageTemplate: Market went up {{benchmarkReturnPercent}}%. You went up {{portfolioReturnPercent}}%. Not bad. Don't get cocky though. The Path is long.
mainReasonTemplate: You outperformed the benchmark.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Sharpen your swords for tomorrow.

messageTemplate: You beat the benchmark's {{benchmarkReturnPercent}}% with a {{portfolioReturnPercent}}% return. I suppose even a fundamentally misguided retail investor is right twice a decade.
mainReasonTemplate: You outperformed the benchmark.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Do not mistake luck for intellect.

messageTemplate: Green day. Benchmark did {{benchmarkReturnPercent}}%, you only managed {{portfolioReturnPercent}}%. You survived the day, but you're still fighting like a novice.
mainReasonTemplate: You underperformed on a green day.
suggestedFocusTemplate: Learn to parry.

messageTemplate: The market practically gave away {{benchmarkReturnPercent}}%, and you only managed {{portfolioReturnPercent}}%. Your inability to capture basic market beta is, frankly, astounding.

suggestedFocusTemplate: Perhaps index funds are more your speed.
